svg.title: End support arrangements
svg.text: End support arrangements – buckling load and critical speed (screw Ø32, root dr = 26.4 mm, span L = 900 mm)
Symbols: hatched block = fixed (angular-contact pair, takes axial + radial load); single bearing = supported (radial only); dashed = buckling / bending mode.
Euler check: F_E = m · π² · E · I / L², I = π·dr⁴/64
• Use the root diameter dr (not d0).
• Buckling: L = distance from the fixed bearing to the
nut in its farthest position under compression.
• Speed: L = span between the bearings (fixed – free:
the overhang). Check the DN limit of the nut too:
• Fixed – fixed + pre-tension: highest rigidity and
